snippet.title: COMANOMALY - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
COMANOMALY is a mix between a whodunnit mystery game & horror game, with different randomly selected culprit each playthrough. It's 1985. You are Susi, a nurse working for Sudaritra Hospital, you have to protect your patient: a wealthy and powerful man with weird symptoms and peculiar conditions.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921560/COMANOMALY/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
